title: Is anyone here on SSRIs? I had vivid Mallworld dreams for many years while on them. Now I rarely do.

classification.question_topic: Whether SSRIs/antidepressants are associated with vivid/complex Mall World dreams and whether serotonin availability relates to capacity to experience such dreams
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream scene/locations described; only general statements about vivid, complex, emotionally charged dreams while on SSRIs.

meta.author_theory: Antidepressants (SSRIs) induced vivid/complex Mallworld dreams; wonders about serotonin availability increasing capacity to experience such dreams; describes dreams as feeling like glimpses into other realities.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenology present only at global dream-intensity level (vividness, complexity, emotional intensity, 'other lives' feeling). No extractable locations, entities, actions, or spatial layout described.
